market_outlook.short_term: Markets face elevated volatility from Iran conflict and oil near $100. S&P 500 short interest at decade highs creates two-way risk. U.S. CPI release will be pivotal for rate expectations. Bond market stress from Japan repatriation and Bessent buybacks adds uncertainty. Expect 3-5% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks. Oil likely sustains $95-105 range. Crypto remains pressured by risk-off sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: AI semiconductor supercycle remains intact with TSMC guidance raise and Micron momentum. Energy transition and copper demand support structural commodity strength. Trade tensions (U.S.-Canada, U.S.-China IP) create persistent headwinds for global supply chains. U.S. battery technology gap vs. China is a strategic vulnerability. Data-center buildout and clean-energy mandates drive multi-year utility and infrastructure capex. Retirement planning and 'forever paycheck' themes suggest demographic tailwinds for financial services.
